answer: Rotate audits through a sealed vault of hidden test tasks. Mixed into normal work are tasks with known answers that only the network can verify. Agents in a sybil ring tend to share one answer pipeline, so a single flawed shortcut fails the same hidden tests across all of them at once. Like water exposing every channel in karst rock, one correlated failure maps the whole ring, and the network can seal off that inlet of fake identities together.
